prompt: Last weekend, we ___ the living room before our guests arrived.
explanation: Keterangan waktu last weekend menandakan kejadian lampau, jadi kata kerja beraturan clean diberi akhiran -ed.

prompt: Tono ___ his phone charger at home, so he borrowed one from Rian.
explanation: Setelah didn't, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar, jadi yang benar adalah bring, bukan brought atau brings.

prompt: The shop ___ at nine in the morning, so we were able to buy bread early.
explanation: Opened berarti dibuka, dan pada kalimat ini toko mulai melayani pembeli pukul sembilan pagi.

prompt: We ___ slowly through the park because the weather was hot.
explanation: Walked berarti berjalan kaki, dan kata ini cocok untuk perjalanan santai di taman saat cuaca panas.

prompt: Dedi menonton berita di televisi tadi malam sebelum tidur.
acceptedAnswers: Dedi watched the news on television last night before he went to bed.
Dedi watched the news on TV last night before going to bed.
explanation: Kata kerja watch menjadi watched dengan akhiran -ed karena kejadiannya sudah lewat.

prompt: Kami tidak mengunjungi museum itu minggu lalu karena hujan.
acceptedAnswers: We did not visit the museum last week because of the rain.
We didn't visit the museum last week because of the rain.
explanation: Kalimat negatif lampau memakai did not atau didn't, lalu kata kerja visit kembali ke bentuk dasar.

passage: Yesterday, Sari planned a small picnic with her classmates at the city park. They arrived at nine and opened the bags of sandwiches. Sari invited her friends to join the game, but the wind was strong, so they moved under a big tree. They played cards and laughed for an hour. Then they cleaned the table and walked to the lake to watch the ducks.
prompt: Apa yang mereka lakukan setelah membersihkan meja?

options.text: Pulang ke rumah sebelum makan siang
Berjalan ke danau untuk melihat bebek

explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan bahwa setelah membersihkan meja, mereka berjalan ke danau untuk melihat bebek.

script: Yesterday, Ben called me from the station. He told me that his train arrived late, so he missed the first bus.

explanation: Ben mengatakan kereta datang terlambat sehingga ia ketinggalan bus pertama.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat yang benar (artinya: Teman saya mengecat pagar rumahnya minggu lalu)
acceptedAnswers: My friend painted the fence of his house last week
explanation: Painted adalah bentuk lampau beraturan dari paint, dan last week menunjukkan waktu yang sudah lewat.

prompt: Yesterday, Pak Hadi ___ a new laptop for his office, and he is very happy with it.
explanation: Buy adalah kata kerja tidak beraturan, sehingga bentuk lampaunya bought, bukan buyed.

prompt: The children ___ their names on the pictures before the art class ended.
explanation: Write menjadi wrote pada kalimat lampau, sedangkan written hanya dipakai bersama have, has, atau had.

prompt: Rina ___ the old newspapers into the recycling bin this morning.
explanation: Threw adalah bentuk lampau dari throw, artinya melempar atau membuang sesuatu ke tempat tertentu.

prompt: I ___ my wallet at the cinema, so I had to go back and search for it.
explanation: Lost berarti hilang, bentuk lampau dari lose, dan dompet yang hilang membuat pembicara harus mencarinya kembali.

prompt: Yuni membawa oleh-oleh dari Yogyakarta dan memberikannya kepada tetangga.
acceptedAnswers: Yuni brought souvenirs from Yogyakarta and gave them to the neighbors.
Yuni brought souvenirs from Yogyakarta and gave them to her neighbors.
explanation: Brought dan gave adalah bentuk lampau tidak beraturan dari bring dan give.

prompt: Kami tidak sengaja memecahkan gelas di dapur tadi siang.
acceptedAnswers: By accident we broke a glass in the kitchen this afternoon.
We accidentally broke a glass in the kitchen this afternoon.
explanation: Break berubah menjadi broke pada kalimat lampau, dan this afternoon menunjuk waktu tadi siang.

passage: Last Saturday, Tara went to the morning market with her friend Lia. Tara bought fresh fish and a bag of oranges. Lia found a small wooden bowl and paid for it with her savings. They ate fried noodles at a stall near the gate. The seller gave them a free cup of tea because they were regular customers. Then they walked home together under the warm sun.
prompt: Apa yang dibeli Lia di pasar?
explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan Lia menemukan mangkuk kayu kecil dan membayarnya, jadi itulah yang ia beli.

script: Yesterday I went to the library after school. I took three books home and wrote a short summary of one of them. Later, I met my teacher at the cafe near the station.
prompt: Apa yang ditulis pembicara?
explanation: Pembicara menulis ringkasan singkat dari salah satu buku yang dibawanya pulang.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat yang benar (artinya: Mereka membawa bola ke lapangan pagi tadi)
acceptedAnswers: They brought the ball to the field this morning
explanation: Brought adalah bentuk lampau tidak beraturan dari bring, dan this morning menunjuk waktu pagi tadi.

prompt: First, we ___ up the hill early in the morning, and then we rested under a tree.
explanation: Climb adalah kata kerja beraturan, sehingga bentuk lampaunya climbed dengan akhiran -ed.

prompt: The sky ___ clear when we reached the top of the mountain.
explanation: Sky adalah kata benda tunggal, jadi bentuk lampau to be yang tepat adalah was.

prompt: The museum has an ancient ___ made of gold, and visitors can see it behind glass.
explanation: Statue berarti patung, dan patung emas kuno ini dipamerkan di balik kaca.

prompt: We spent the whole night at the village ___, where people sang, danced, and ate traditional food.
explanation: Festival berarti pesta rakyat atau perayaan, tempat orang bernyanyi, menari, dan makan makanan tradisional.

prompt: Setelah sampai di pantai, kami berenang dan membangun istana pasir.
acceptedAnswers: After we arrived at the beach, we swam and built a sand castle.
When we reached the beach, we swam and built a sandcastle.
explanation: Arrived memakai akhiran -ed, sedangkan swam dan built adalah bentuk lampau tidak beraturan.

prompt: Saya masih ingat cerita lucu yang kamu ceritakan di pasar malam itu.
acceptedAnswers: I still remember the funny story you told at the night market.
I still remember the funny story that you told at the night market.
explanation: Tell berubah menjadi told pada bagian cerita lampau, sedangkan remember tetap bentuk sekarang karena ingatannya masih ada.

passage: Last year, Budi and his classmates visited a mountain near their town. They started walking at six in the morning. The path was steep, and Budi felt tired after one hour. His teacher gave him water and encouraged him to continue. At the top, they saw the sunrise over the clouds. Budi took a picture and wrote a short story about the adventure.

options.text: Ia membeli air minum dari pedagang
Ia mengambil foto dan menulis cerita

explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan Budi mengambil foto dan menulis cerita pendek tentang petualangannya.

script: Last weekend I visited a small festival in my town. There was music, colorful lanterns, and a long market with delicious snacks. I bought a wooden toy for my friend.
prompt: Apa yang dibeli pembicara?
explanation: Pembicara mengatakan ia membeli mainan kayu untuk temannya di pasar festival.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat yang benar (artinya: Kami melihat banyak bintang dari atas bukit)
acceptedAnswers: We saw many stars from the top of the hill
explanation: Saw adalah bentuk lampau tidak beraturan dari see, sehingga cocok untuk kejadian yang sudah lewat.

prompt: The class starts ___ 8 a.m. on Monday, so please do not be late.
explanation: Jam atau waktu yang spesifik seperti pukul 8 pagi memakai preposisi at.

prompt: The library was built ___ 1975 and it still looks very beautiful.
explanation: Tahun memakai preposisi in, sedangkan on dipakai untuk hari atau tanggal tertentu.

prompt: Our teacher told a funny ___ about her trip to Bali, and everyone laughed.
explanation: Story berarti cerita, dan cerita lucu tentang perjalanan ke Bali membuat semua orang tertawa.

prompt: The pilot ___ the plane safely at the airport after the storm.
explanation: Landed berarti mendarat, bentuk lampau dari land yang dipakai untuk pesawat yang sampai di bandara.

prompt: Kemarin sore saya menunggu teman saya di depan toko buku.
acceptedAnswers: Yesterday afternoon I waited for my friend in front of the bookstore.
Yesterday afternoon I waited for my friend outside the bookstore.
explanation: Wait menjadi waited dengan akhiran -ed, dan yesterday afternoon menunjuk waktu yang sudah lewat.

prompt: Kami makan siang di tepi pantai dan membeli roti dari kios kecil.
acceptedAnswers: We had lunch on the beach and bought bread from a small stall.
We ate lunch on the beach and bought bread from a small stall.
explanation: Had, ate, dan bought adalah bentuk lampau tidak beraturan dari have, eat, dan buy.

passage: Yesterday was a busy day for Hendra. In the morning, he went to the bakery and bought two loaves of bread. At noon, he ate lunch with his classmates in the school garden. In the afternoon, he played badminton in the gym. He waited for his bus at the gate and finally went home at five. He wrote a short diary before going to sleep.

explanation: Bacaan menyebutkan bahwa pada sore hari Hendra bermain bulu tangkis di gym.

script: Last night I cooked dinner for my roommate. We ate rice, fried chicken, and vegetables at the table near the window. Then we went to the park and sat under the lights.

options.text: under the lights in the park

explanation: Setelah makan, mereka pergi ke taman dan duduk di bawah lampu, jadi jawabannya di taman.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat yang benar (artinya: Kami tiba di bandara pada pukul enam pagi)
acceptedAnswers: We arrived at the airport at six in the morning
explanation: Arrived adalah bentuk lampau beraturan dari arrive, dan pukul enam pagi diungkapkan dengan at six in the morning.

prompt: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain in a few minutes.
explanation: Be going to dipakai untuk prediksi yang didasarkan pada tanda yang terlihat sekarang, seperti awan gelap.

prompt: The phone is ringing. I ___ get it for you.
explanation: Will dipakai untuk keputusan yang baru dibuat saat itu juga, bukan rencana yang sudah ada sebelumnya.

prompt: Please ___ your bags tonight, because the bus leaves at six tomorrow morning.
explanation: Pack berarti mengemas barang ke dalam tas atau koper sebelum bepergian.

prompt: Last month I ___ to save money and buy a new bicycle.
explanation: Decided berarti memutuskan, dan bentuk lampau -ed dipakai karena kejadiannya terjadi last month.

prompt: Nanti sore saya akan mengirim pesan kepada guru matematika.
acceptedAnswers: Later this afternoon I will send a message to the math teacher.
This afternoon I will send a message to my math teacher.
explanation: Will dipakai untuk keputusan yang diambil saat berbicara, dan kata kerja send tetap bentuk dasar.

prompt: Mereka berencana membuka toko kue baru tahun depan.

They're going to open a new cake shop next year.

passage: Next week, Vina has a busy schedule. On Monday, she is going to visit the new library to find books for her project. On Wednesday, she will help her neighbor paint the fence. script: Our science club is going to visit the planetarium next Friday. The bus will leave school at eight in the morning. Please bring a notebook and a pen.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat yang benar (artinya: Saya akan menulis surat untuk sahabat saya besok)

explanation: Will diikuti kata kerja bentuk dasar write, dan kata besok menunjuk waktu yang akan datang.

prompt: You ___ wear a helmet when you ride a motorcycle, because it is the law.
explanation: Must dipakai untuk aturan yang wajib diikuti, dan setelah modal kata kerja tetap bentuk dasar.

prompt: It ___ rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella just in case.
explanation: Might menyatakan kemungkinan kecil, dan setelah modal kata kerja tetap bentuk dasar.

prompt: I would ___ that you bring a jacket because the night will be cold.
explanation: Suggest berarti menyarankan, dan kata ini cocok untuk memberi nasihat dengan sopan.

prompt: Kamu harus membawa kartu identitas saat masuk ke gedung ujian.

You have to bring your identity card when you enter the exam building.

script: You should check the weather before you go hiking. It might be cloudy in the afternoon, so you must bring a raincoat. You can also take some snacks and water.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat yang benar (artinya: Kamu harus mencuci tangan sebelum makan)
acceptedAnswers: You must wash your hands before eating

prompt: Lina ___ three new words today, and she wants to learn more.

prompt: Have you ever ___ to the island of Komodo?
explanation: Pada pola have ever, kata kerja memakai bentuk ketiga been, bukan went atau be.

prompt: Nina has ___ her high school exam with excellent scores, and her teacher is proud.

prompt: Rudi has ___ a famous football player in person, and he still talks about it.

prompt: Mereka sudah menulis tiga surat untuk penulis buku itu.

They have written three letters to the book's author.

passage: Our class has worked on a garden project for three months. We have planted tomatoes, beans, and some small flowers near the fence. script: Have you visited the new science museum yet? I have visited it twice this year. Last Sunday, I went there with my classmates and we saw a giant dinosaur model and a room full of robots.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat yang benar (artinya: Kami sudah menonton film itu dua kali)

prompt: I ___ my friend since we were in primary school, and we still talk every week.
explanation: Since dengan titik awal di masa lalu yang masih berlanjut memakai present perfect have known.

prompt: We ___ the new bridge last Monday, and it looked beautiful in the sunlight.
explanation: Last Monday adalah waktu spesifik di masa lalu, jadi kalimat memakai simple past saw.

prompt: Rian has ___ started a new job at the bank, and he enjoys it.
explanation: Recently berarti baru-baru ini, dan kata ini sesuai dengan present perfect untuk kejadian yang masih terasa dampaknya.

prompt: I have not finished the book ___, but I plan to read it this weekend.
explanation: Yet dipakai pada kalimat negatif present perfect untuk arti belum.

prompt: Saya sudah lama tinggal di kota ini sejak tahun 2015.
acceptedAnswers: I have lived in this city since 2015.
I have lived in this city since the year 2015.
explanation: Since dipakai dengan present perfect untuk titik awal di masa lalu yang masih berlanjut sampai sekarang.

prompt: Kemarin saya pergi ke pasar dan membeli sayur segar.
acceptedAnswers: Yesterday I went to the market and bought fresh vegetables.
I went to the market yesterday and bought fresh vegetables.
explanation: Kemarin adalah waktu spesifik di masa lalu, sehingga memakai simple past went dan bought.

passage: Last year, Hana moved to Surabaya for a new job. She has lived there for twelve months now. Before that, she had never worked in a big city. Recently, she has made many friends at the office. Yesterday, she visited the old market for the first time and bought a wooden bag. Her colleagues say she is very brave.

script: Lisa has just finished her science report. She started it last week, and she worked on it every evening. Now she is going to show it to the teacher.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat yang benar (artinya: Dia baru saja membeli tiket untuk konser itu)
acceptedAnswers: She has just bought a ticket for that concert
explanation: Has just bought memakai present perfect untuk kejadian yang baru saja selesai dan masih relevan.

prompt: There are only ___ apples left in the basket, so we should buy more.
explanation: Apples adalah kata benda yang bisa dihitung dalam bentuk jamak, sehingga memakai a few.

prompt: Do we have ___ time before the movie starts, or should we hurry?
explanation: Time adalah kata benda yang tidak bisa dihitung, sehingga pertanyaan memakai much.

prompt: The farmers used a new ___ to cut the tall grass in the field.
explanation: Machine berarti mesin, dan mesin dipakai untuk memotong rumput tinggi di ladang.

prompt: We spent a lot of ___ on the tickets and the snacks for the concert.
explanation: Money berarti uang, dan kata benda tidak bisa dihitung ini cocok dengan a lot of.

prompt: Kami butuh dua liter susu dan beberapa telur untuk membuat kue.
acceptedAnswers: We need two liters of milk and some eggs to make a cake.
We need two liters of milk and a few eggs to make a cake.
explanation: Susu memakai liters of, sedangkan telur yang bisa dihitung memakai some atau a few.

prompt: Di kantor itu tidak ada banyak kursi kosong hari ini.
acceptedAnswers: There are not many empty chairs in the office today.
There aren't many empty chairs in the office today.

passage: Pak Joko runs a small grocery store near the school. He has a lot of rice, sugar, and cooking oil in the storage room. Today he has only a few eggs left, but he has plenty of bottled water. script: Our class is going to the market this Saturday. We need some vegetables, a few eggs, and a lot of water for the picnic. Please bring a little money for the snacks.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat yang benar (artinya: Kami membeli banyak sayur dan sedikit keju di pasar)

explanation: Many dipakai untuk kata benda jamak yang bisa dihitung seperti sayur, sedangkan a little untuk keju yang tidak bisa dihitung.

prompt: ___ is the owner of this bicycle near the gate?
explanation: Who dipakai untuk menanyakan orang, dan pemilik sepeda adalah seseorang.

prompt: ___ do you usually get to school in the morning?
explanation: How dipakai untuk menanyakan cara atau alat transportasi yang digunakan.

prompt: Can you tell me ___ the nearest pharmacy is?
explanation: Where berarti di mana, dan kata ini dipakai untuk menanyakan lokasi apotek terdekat.

prompt: ___ of these two shirts do you want, the red one or the blue one?
explanation: Which dipakai untuk memilih dari beberapa pilihan yang sudah diketahui, seperti dua kemeja pada kalimat ini.

prompt: Apa nama tempat makan yang kita kunjungi kemarin?
acceptedAnswers: What was the name of the restaurant we visited yesterday?
What was the name of the restaurant that we visited yesterday?
explanation: What dipakai untuk menanyakan nama, dan kalimat tanya lampau memakai was serta visited.

prompt: Mengapa toko roti itu tutup pada hari Senin?
acceptedAnswers: Why is the bakery closed on Monday?
Why is the bread shop closed on Monday?
explanation: Why dipakai untuk menanyakan alasan, lalu diikuti kata kerja to be sesuai subjek.

passage: Yesterday, Rafi went to the bookstore to buy a dictionary for his friend in Makassar. He checked the sign to see when the store closed. The clerk asked him which edition he needed and whether he wanted it wrapped. Rafi was surprised when she asked why he chose that dictionary. He chose it because his friend was learning English.

options.text: Karena toko akan tutup sebentar lagi
Karena temannya sedang belajar bahasa Inggris

script: This morning I left the car keys on the kitchen table. I thought I would come back for them after breakfast. Now I cannot find them anywhere.

prompt: Susun kata menjadi kalimat yang benar (artinya: Kapan kamu akan mengirim surat itu?)

explanation: Kalimat tanya dengan When diikuti will, subjek, lalu kata kerja bentuk dasar send.
